description: This file contains shell functions for handling Linux system upgrades, including checking image compatibility, copying configurations, updating EFI system partitions, and performing full system upgrades for devices running OpenWRT or similar embedded Linux systems.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the upgrade image has the same partition layout as the current system, preventing unnecessary full rewrites.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a specific partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates EFI system partition files (like EFI boot loaders) from the new image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a full upgrade process, including updating partitions, EFI files, and root filesystem.
